_readme: Known symbols for ES1's FM MIDI driver fmmidi.com (ES1FMMIDI), an image of SOS/HMIMDRV.386: confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the driver image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/hmi-driver-container.md#an-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.
